column1: # STRUCTURE DEBT REGISTER (this package's own) v1.2.0 -- the lines of pib-hub, and of no other package.
# The owner ruled on 2026-10-07 that a package carries its own register and clears its own lines in its own release, which is
# what BP-D54 always said; the governance aggregate carries the ceilings and the ecosystem-wide view.
# A line may be removed here, and a count lowered here, with nobody else involved: debt may always shrink. A count may NOT be
# raised here, a line the aggregate does not carry may NOT be added, and a status may NOT be raised to `exception`: the checker
# fails the run and the aggregate generator refuses it, keeping the previous ceiling. Those go through the owner's ruling,
# recorded in the aggregate line as `ruling: ...`.
# v1.0.0 (PIB v2.19.0): the first measurement of the GOVERNED HOME -- 18 lines. The nine lines the governance handover offered
#   were not adopted: they measure Ontologies/pib-hub/, the retired monorepo directory, at file versions this repository left
#   behind. That difference was reported to OE rather than reconciled quietly.
# v1.1.0 (PIB v2.20.0): the four N1 lines are gone -- every file whose name broke the version pattern was reissued under a
#   conforming name and version, and the old ones left the package. 18 lines -> 14.
# v1.2.0 (PIB v2.21.0): 14 lines -> 9, by putting three sets of files in the folder class that describes what they are, read
#   from the governance session's own class table (OE_STRUCTURE_CLASSES v1.7.0) rather than guessed:
#     - the three spoke contributions are COPIES OF OTHER PACKAGES (class C1, `dirstart=vendored`), not PIB's terms to split
#       or absorb; they moved to 07-spoke-contributions/vendored/. Three R1 lines gone, and the T and A counts fell with them.
#     - the five operator fixtures are TEST INPUTS (class T1, `dir=fixtures`), which is exactly what they are -- deliberately
#       violating candidates and spaces whose capacities are known independently; they moved to 12-operator-fixtures/fixtures/.
#     - the superseded round-one ORCP submission is RETIRED HISTORY (class H1, `dir=archive`); it moved to
#       08-registration/archive/, bytes unchanged, which is what the two V1 lines were about. Both V1 lines gone.
#   No file was edited to achieve any of this, and every tool that named a moved file was repointed in the same release.
